description_en: Create a playlist and play the specified content
description_zh: 创建播放列表并播放指定的内容
name: CreatePlayingList

fields.help_en:
Playback source, the UUID for configuring playback control capabilities.

Can be empty. Default is "default"
fields.help_zh:
播放来源,配置播控能力的唯一标识

可空，默认为default
fields.name: play_from

fields.help_en:
Content type for playback.

Values: "content" for content, "album" for album, and "collect" for playlist
fields.help_zh:
播放内容类型

内容：content；专辑：album；歌单：collect
fields.name: content_type

element_fields.help_en:
Third-party ID.

If the content type is "content", this is the content ID. If it is "album", this is the album ID
element_fields.help_zh:
三方id

如果是内容则是内容id；如果是专辑则是专辑id
element_fields.name: raw_id

fields.help_en:
Playback content list.

If the content type is "content", multiple entries are supported. If it is "album", only the first entry takes effect
fields.help_zh:
播放内容列表

若是内容，支持多个；若是专辑，只有第一个有效
fields.name: content_list

fields.help_en:
Playback index.

Can be empty. Default is 0, indicating playback starts from the beginning
fields.help_zh:
播放的index

可空。默认为0，表示从头播放
fields.name: index

fields.help_en: Whether to resume album playback. For example, if the user previously listened up to episode 5 of an album, whether to continue from episode 5. Default is true
fields.help_zh: 专辑是否续播，比如上次专辑听到第五集，是否继续从第五集开始。默认为true
fields.name: need_album_continued

fields.help_en:
Playback pattern.

Repeat: list loop; Shuffle: random; RepeatOne: single track loop; Normal: sequential playback
fields.help_zh:
播放模式

列表循环：Repeat；随机：Shuffle；单曲循环：RepeatOne；顺序播放：Normal
fields.name: play_mode

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.

`PACKAGE_NAME`: APK package name, used as the encoding type for the Android application customer link.  
`SKILL_ID`: Skill ID, used as the encoding type for the cloud-based link
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型。

`PACKAGE_NAME：`apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型。
`SKILL_ID`：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
Value corresponding to the encoding type.

When the encoding type is `SKILL_ID`, the value is the application's Skill ID.  
When the encoding type is `PACKAGE_NAME`, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值

编码类型是`SKILL_ID`时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
编码类型是`PACKAGE_NAME`时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en:
Type of User ID.

`OPEN_ID`: Default User ID identity.  
`UNION_ID`: Organization-dimension User ID identity. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie skill application Open Platform
fields.help_zh:
用户Id的类型

OPEN_ID：默认的用户ID标识。
UNION_ID: 组织维度的用户ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用开放平台申请过组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: User identifier, set to either userOpenId or userUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required if IdType is UNION_ID
fields.name: organization_id
